subject: from conversation with bruno earlier this year
text:

We spoke with Bruno earlier this year about the surgical planning workflow,
mainly auto segmenting CT scans where the anatomy is unique.

flagged as hardest.

I wanted to get your input on how you were thinking about this, we have
availability Thursday (30th) at 10:00am if that works for you?
